name: Hillary Clinton

lean.basis: Democratic U.S. senator from New York (2001–2009), Secretary of State under Obama and the 2016 Democratic presidential nominee.

source.title: File:Former United States Secretary of State Hillary Rodham Clinton at the U.S. Department of State on September 26, 2023 in Washington, D.C. 14 (cropped).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Former Secretary of State (2009–2013) and 2016 Democratic presidential nominee
summary: Hillary Clinton was first lady (1993–2001), a U.S. senator from New York (2001–2009) and Barack Obama's secretary of state (2009–2013). She lost the 2008 Democratic primary to Obama and, as the 2016 Democratic nominee, won the popular vote but lost the Electoral College to Donald Trump. She endorsed Biden in 2020 and Harris in 2024.

timeline.role: Democratic nominee for president; lost the Electoral College to Donald Trump
